fib: ______ is the central line about which the cone is symmetric.
axis
The axis is the central line about which the cone is symmetric.
______ can be defined as set of points in the coordinate plane.
Hyperbola
Hyperbola can be defined as set of points in the coordinate plane.
______ is a line which, when rotated about the axis, sweeps out the cone.
generator
A generator is a line which, when rotated about the axis, sweeps out the cone.
______ are known as the foci (singular focus), which are surrounded by the curve, The fixed line is directrix and constant ratio is eccentricity of ellipse.
fixed points
The fixed points are known as the foci (singular focus), which are surrounded by the curve, The fixed line is directrix and constant ratio is eccentricity of ellipse.
______ is defined as the product of magnitude of vector 𝐴 and magnitude of component of vector 𝐵 in the direction of vector 𝐴 (vice-versa).
scalar
The scalar is defined as the product of magnitude of vector 𝐴 and magnitude of component of vector 𝐵 in the direction of vector 𝐴 (vice-versa).
______ is called semi-major axis and half of minor axis is called semi-minor axis (see Fig 3.1.1).
Half of major axis
Half of major axis is called semi-major axis and half of minor axis is called semi-minor axis (see Fig 3.1.1).
______ is the longest diameter of the ellipse, going through the centre from one end to the other, at the broad part of the ellipse.
major axis
The major axis is the longest diameter of the ellipse, going through the centre from one end to the other, at the broad part of the ellipse.
